name: naoto24kawa-claude-plugins
description: Agent toolkit: cross-agent skills (skills.sh compatible) plus Claude Code plugins — development process infrastructure, specification document generation, and exploratory QA testing

plugins.name: dev-tools
plugins.description: Development toolset. Includes: (1) spec — specification document generation, incremental update, and drift detection via 9 specialized sub-agents; (2) site-explorer — exploratory QA testing for any web app with automatic bug detection and GitHub Issue registration; (3) parallel-review-cycle skill — iterative parallel specialist review until zero findings; (4) tmux-manager — tmux visibility and orphan cleanup with human-gated deletion; (5) agmsg unread-send hook — Stop hook that surfaces agmsg messages this agent sent that remain unread, within a bounded staleness window (visibility only); (6) guardrails — kill-switch / path-allowlist / rate-fuse / audit-log の hook 実装とスキル内パターン集（既定では未配線）.

plugins.name: elchika-tools
plugins.description: Local MCP server exposing 34 Elchika Tools utilities. Text transform, encode/decode, format, crypto, and generate tools — all running locally, no data leaves your machine.
